name: Track Analysis
author: pedro
summary: Generate missing phrases and vocal intervals for USB and Beatport tracks.
description: Generates missing phrases against the loaded native beat grid and missing vocal intervals with the reconstructed LSTM and locally imported model weights. All decoder, phrase and vocal code is C and runs inside the mod with up to three low-priority analysis threads on the A53 cores, including parallel phrase/vocal stages. Uses typed SDK grid and result interfaces. Preserves populated grids, phrases, PVDI, cues and waveforms. Supports USB OneLibrary and completed Beatport downloads; folder-only tracks, encrypted media and HE-AAC are unsupported.
